name: adidas Yeezy Slides 'Salt'
story_html: The adidas Yeezy Slide ‘Salt’ carries a lightweight build crafted from injected EVA foam and rendered in a monochromatic grey finish. Exterior branding is limited to adidas’ three-stripe logo debossed on the footbed, featuring a soft top layer for step-in comfort. Open-toe construction provides improved airflow, while the outsole utilizes a series of deep horizontal grooves, resulting in a serrated traction pattern for cushioning and grip.
